_comment: Clusters a reviewer has already ruled on. audit_duplicates.py regenerates
duplicates.json from scratch on every run, so a verdict recorded only there
is lost on the next run and the cluster goes back to blocking. This file is
the durable half: the audit reads it and stamps the recorded verdict instead
A decision is keyed by the exact set of member uids it was made about. If a
question in the cluster is later edited, removed or joined by a third, the
key stops matching and the cluster returns to REVIEW -- a ruling applies to
what the reviewer actually read, not to whatever the cluster becomes.
